note: Cutscene scripts. Times are story seconds; `pace` maps story time to real seconds ([story start, story end, playback rate], rate < 1 slows the scene so captions can be read; null end = open). The game reads the intro from here (src/data/introScript.js) and the bible's Videos tab renders every entry. Scene ids match camera shots in introScript.js. Keep public/data/videos.json in sync for the deployed bible.

videos.title: Count Null's First Collapse
videos.plays: New Game, before World 0 · Level 1

scenes.title: The Winding World
scenes.description: Fade in from black. Slow descending fly-in over Retract Reef at night: the long Walkway ending at the Landing Pier, the T-shaped Fork, the O, the round reef of Twin Lagoons, Tidewarp Flats, the Mirror Shoals and the Foundry cliff, all strung on glowing causeways around the ringed island at the center. Gyroid is a small figure on the Walkway in the foreground. (The same layout as the World 0 map and the playable overworld.)

scenes.title: The ringed island
scenes.description: Close, slow orbit around the central ringed island, intact, its eight amber beacons lit. Causeways arc away from it to the other islands.

scenes.title: Gyroid on the reef
scenes.description: Gyroid stands idle on the thick basalt walkway with its amber spine, facing along the path. The camera eases in from a three-quarter front angle. Gyroid's theme plays.

scenes.title: Establishing orbit
scenes.description: Wide orbit high over the whole world, settling toward the ringed island at its center. Black spire visible in the distance.

scenes.title: Count Null revealed
scenes.description: On top of his black spire, the camera rises from Null's robe hem up to his porcelain mask while the Null Crown floats down onto its place above his hood (7–9.6). At 9.6 the crown begins to glow and he half-raises his open hand; fragments orbit above his palm.

scenes.title: The thrust
scenes.description: Over Null's shoulder: he thrusts his hand toward the ring (13.6–14.4). A violet beam fires from the crown to the ringed island (14.0).

scenes.title: The collapse
scenes.description: Wide on the ring. It turns violet and flickers (from 14.2); its hole closes as it swells into a ball (14.6–19), shrinks to a point (19.1–20) and vanishes in a white-violet flash (19.9) with camera shake. The four causeways tied to the ring snap loose and fall into the sea (19.6–22.5).

scenes.title: The run
scenes.description: Tracking shot alongside Gyroid sprinting down the walkway (21–27.6). Behind them, the basalt slabs shudder, turn violet and fall away one by one, but the amber spine stays in place.

scenes.title: The edge
scenes.description: Gyroid stops at the end of the walkway and turns toward camera, looking back at the ruined path where only the spine remains.

scenes.title: Anchor set
scenes.description: Gyroid casts the anchor spool: a luminous loop opens around them (30.9–32.2) and drops onto the spine (32.4–33.4), which flares bright. Camera pulls back and up.

scenes.title: Null watches
scenes.description: Back on the spire: Null, calm, watches from afar and gives a small dismissive gesture (36.5–39).

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Wide pull-back over Retract Reef with the ringed island now missing from the center — open water where it stood. Title card fades in at 40.5: “Winding World — Shape can change. Topology can’t.” and “World 0 · Level 1 — A Good Deformation”. Fade to black at 46, then Level 1 starts.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Beyond the edge of every map lies the Winding World: islands shaped like rings and loops, strung together by glowing causeways.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Here the land is soft. It stretches, bends and drifts with the tides — and nothing is lost, so long as nothing tears.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: What the land truly guards are its holes. Stretch a ring as far as you like and it stays a ring — and every route around it holds.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Gyroid, a courier born of the surfaces themselves, runs messages along those routes, an anchor spool always at the hip.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: One delivery for Emmy Boundary, out on Retract Reef. Easy run today.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: But high on a spire of black glass, someone had been counting those holes — and he meant to be rid of every one.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: So many loops. So many… holes.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Enough. I will simplify every province — down to a single perfect point.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: But the Null Crown does not simplify. It erases.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: A ring becomes a ball. A ball becomes a point. Every route that wound through it — gone.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Gyroid! The reef is going — stay on the amber spines! Whatever keeps its shape, we can save!

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The walkways fell… but the spines held. Bend it, don’t break it.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Anchor set!

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: A courier who keeps holes. How… quaint. Run along, little loop.

videos.title: Spines That Held
videos.plays: Before World 0 · Level 1 — right after the opening intro
videos.synopsis: Morning after the collapse. Gyroid comes to at the Landing Pier; the walkway slabs are gone but the amber spines held. Emmy arrives and frames 0-1: thick walkways can be shrunk onto their spines without losing anything that matters. Null's spawn roam the reef — spheres pop with one lash, tori need two.

scenes.title: Landing Pier, dawn
scenes.description: Low sun over Retract Reef. Gyroid lies on the small basalt landing pier, spool beside them, and sits up. Behind, the walkway's slabs are gone; only the glowing amber spine still spans the water.

scenes.title: Emmy arrives
scenes.description: Emmy Boundary steps off a small skiff onto the pier, goggles up, a triangular cell glowing in her glove. She kneels by the spine and runs a finger along it.

scenes.title: Shrinking, not breaking
scenes.description: Emmy projects a glowing demo above her palm: a thick slab of reef with an amber line down its middle; every point of the slab slides onto the line along faint guides, and the line itself never moves. The slab ends as just the line.

scenes.title: Spawn on the reef
scenes.description: Across the reef, violet spheres and a violet torus drift onto the walkways. Gyroid uncoils the gold lash; a quick crack pops a sphere into a point. The torus shrugs off one lash, glowing one gold loop.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Gyroid jogs onto the first walkway. Title card at 28: “World 0 · Level 1 — A Good Deformation”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: By morning the walkways had fallen into the sea. But the amber spines were still there.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: You must be my courier. You kept the spines. Good — that's all we need.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: All we need? The whole reef is gone.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: A thick walkway and its spine are the same shape. Slide every point onto the spine — slowly, no jumps — and nothing that matters is lost.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Just never move the spine itself.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Null's spawn first. Spheres are slippery — every loop slides off. One lash.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: And the ring-shaped ones?

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: A torus holds two loops it can't shed. Two lashes.

videos.title: The Tide Bends Everything
videos.plays: Before World 0 · Level 2, when Gyroid reaches Tidewarp Flats
videos.synopsis: Past the broken causeway (bridged with the Spool), the tide reshapes Tidewarp Flats every hour. Emmy frames 0-2: a homotopy is a whole continuous movie of maps, and a homotopy 'rel A' keeps some posts fixed throughout. Null offers a cheat — send everything to one point instantly — and Emmy names the difference between a retraction and a deformation.

scenes.title: Bridging the gap
scenes.description: The broken causeway from Twin Lagoons. Gyroid runs a gold Spool thread across the gap; it firms into a spine and the causeway knits along it. Beyond: wide wet tidal flats.

scenes.title: The tide
scenes.description: On the flats, glowing gold ribbon paths lie between stone posts. The tide rolls in and every ribbon bends smoothly into a new shape — ghost copies trace the motion. One middle post stays lit and every ribbon passes through it the whole time.

scenes.title: Null's shortcut
scenes.description: A violet flash: Count Null's image hangs over the water. With a flick he sends a ribbon to a single point — no motion in between, it simply snaps there. Sparks of violet where it tore.

scenes.title: Emmy's answer
scenes.description: Emmy kneels by a ribbon and slows the tide with a gesture; the ribbon bends frame by frame, the fixed post never moving. Gyroid lays a hand on the post.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Wide over the flats as the tide turns. Title card at 28: “World 0 · Level 2 — Bend, Don't Break”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Spool bridged the broken causeway. Beyond it, the tide had its own ideas.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Tidewarp Flats. Every hour the tide reshapes every path out here — continuously, one moment flowing into the next.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: That whole movie of shapes is a homotopy.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Why wait for the tide? I can send every path to one point. Instantly.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Every space retracts to a point, courier.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: A retraction can be one snap. A deformation is the whole movie — every frame in between — and with a pool in the way, no such movie exists.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: And these posts never move while the tide works?

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: That's a homotopy $rel$ those posts: they stay still the whole time.

videos.title: Two Reefs, One Shape
videos.plays: Before World 0 · Level 3, at Mirror Shoals
videos.synopsis: At Mirror Shoals two reefs face each other across a glassy channel — a figure-eight and a theta, two of the spines Gyroid found for Twin Lagoons. They look different. Emmy frames 0-3: build maps both ways so that each round trip can be deformed back to where it started, and the two are the same shape — homotopy equivalent. The Mirror Gate to the Skeleton Foundry only opens for someone who can show it.

scenes.title: Mirror Shoals
scenes.description: A still channel reflecting the stars. On the left a thick figure-eight reef, on the right a thick theta reef. A slender stone bridge crosses between them to a tall arched gate of mirrored basalt.

scenes.title: Remember the lagoons
scenes.description: Brief flashback overlay: Twin Lagoons, with a figure-eight spine and then a theta spine, both shrinking the same reef.

scenes.title: Threads both ways
scenes.description: Emmy throws gold threads from points of the figure-eight across the channel to the theta, then back again; a round-trip thread returns near where it started and slides home.

scenes.title: The gate
scenes.description: The Mirror Gate shows Gyroid's reflection, then the two reefs side by side. It stays shut. Behind it, through a crack, forge-light glows: the Skeleton Foundry.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Gyroid steps onto the bridge between the reefs. Title card at 30: “World 0 · Level 3 — Same Shape, Different Look”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Mirror Shoals: two reefs facing each other across a channel so still it could be glass.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: I know these. The figure-eight and the theta — both were spines of Twin Lagoons.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: But they don't look alike at all.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Looks aren't the test. Send each one into the other, then back. If every round trip slides home…

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: …they're the same shape. Homotopy equivalent.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The Mirror Gate opens for anyone who can show it. Past it is the Foundry.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: You sound like you've been through it before.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: …Let's just get it open.

videos.title: Emmy's Foundry
videos.plays: Before World 0 · Level 4, entering the Skeleton Foundry's Assembly Hall
videos.synopsis: The Mirror Gate opens onto the Skeleton Foundry. In the Assembly Hall, Emmy's secret comes out: she built the first cell presses here, and Null's engineers bent them into collapse engines. She gives Gyroid the Cell-Smith and frames 0-4: places are built in stages — points, then edges glued at their ends, then disks glued along loops. A square with its edges glued a, b, a⁻¹, b⁻¹ becomes a torus.

scenes.title: Through the Mirror Gate
scenes.description: The gate swings open onto a basalt valley of cold forges, cranes and disk presses, faintly violet with Null's corruption. Gyroid and Emmy walk in.

scenes.title: The plaque
scenes.description: Inside the Assembly Hall, Emmy stops at the oldest press. On its frame, a small triangular maker's mark matching the patches on her coat. Gyroid notices.

scenes.title: Confession
scenes.description: Close on Emmy. A memory overlay: younger Emmy at the presses, couriers' routes on a board being simplified; then violet engineers re-tooling the presses into collapse engines.

scenes.title: The Cell-Smith
scenes.description: Emmy hands Gyroid a brass-and-indigo gauntlet. Above its palm: a point, then an edge whose ends meet into a loop, then a disk pressed onto the loop. A glowing square folds — one pair of edges into a tube, the tube's ends into a torus.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Gyroid flexes the gauntlet at a forge as it relights gold. Title card at 32: “World 0 · Level 4 — Some Assembly Required”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Mirror Gate opened onto the Skeleton Foundry — where the world's places were built.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Emmy. That mark on the press — it's the same as the patches on your coat.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: I built these. I thought simpler routes would make the couriers' lives easier.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Null's people turned them into something that erases.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: So we build things back. Points first. Then edges, glued at their ends. Then disks, glued along loops.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Glue a square's edges a, b, a⁻¹, b⁻¹ and you get a torus. Watch the arrows.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The Cell-Smith. Let's put this place back together.

videos.title: Null's Plugs
videos.plays: Before World 0 · Level 5, at the Cone Zone
videos.synopsis: On the Cone Zone terrace, Null's engineers are 'fixing' ring islands by coning them off — joining every point of a ring to one apex, which fills the hole. Emmy frames 0-5: operations on spaces — cone, suspension, wedge, product — and which cells each one adds. Recognizing a cone is how you spot a hole that's been plugged.

scenes.title: The terrace
scenes.description: A basalt terrace with workstations over the sea. At one, violet spawn hover around a glowing ring, stringing lines from every point of it up to a single apex.

scenes.title: A plugged ring
scenes.description: The coned ring is now a solid cone; a courier route that used to loop through the ring dead-ends against it. Violet light pulses.

scenes.title: The operations
scenes.description: Emmy walks the stations: a cone (one apex), a suspension (two apexes, above and below), two loops joined at one point (a wedge), and a small circle swept around a large one (a product — a torus).

scenes.title: Spawn turn
scenes.description: The spawn notice Gyroid and drift toward the stations. Gyroid readies the lash.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 28: “World 0 · Level 5 — Cone Zone”.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: What are they doing to that ring?

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Coning it. Every point of the ring joined to one tip. It fills the hole — the ring becomes a cone, and a cone has nothing left to wind around.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Not erased. Completed. Isn't it tidier?

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Learn the operations, and you'll know a plug when you see one.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: One tip: a cone. A tip above and below: a suspension. Two loops at one point: a wedge. A circle swept around a circle: a torus.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: And the torus I built in the Hall — it's the same as the swept one?

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Prove it. Count their cells.

videos.title: Timber Yard
videos.plays: Before World 0 · Level 6, at the Timber Yard
videos.synopsis: The Timber Yard's walkway network has grown into a tangle. Emmy frames 0-6: collapsing a tree of edges — any edge with two different ends — doesn't change the shape; collapse a spanning tree and the tangle becomes a bouquet of loops at one point. Collapsing a loop is what Null does, and that erases a hole. Counting vertices minus edges (χ) tells bouquets apart. The bridge to the Hollow Throne is past the yard, still unbuilt.

scenes.title: The tangle
scenes.description: A web of narrow basalt walkways linking many small platforms over the sea, crossing and doubling back. At the far edge, an unbuilt bridge reaches toward a black spire: the Hollow Throne.

scenes.title: Felling the tree
scenes.description: Emmy highlights a tree of walkways in amber — branching, never closing a loop. The amber walkways fold toward a single platform; the remaining walkways become loops leaving and returning to it, like petals.

scenes.title: The wrong cut
scenes.description: A violet spawn bites through a petal loop and collapses it; a hole winks out and the bouquet loses a petal. Emmy winces.

scenes.title: Counting
scenes.description: Emmy tallies platforms and walkways on her glove — the difference stays the same before and after felling the tree. She points across to the Throne.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Gyroid steps into the tangle, lash ready. Title card at 30: “World 0 · Level 6 — Timber!”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Timber Yard: walkways grown into a tangle no courier could follow.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Find a tree — walkways that branch but never close a loop. Any edge with two different ends can shrink to a point.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Fell the whole tree, and the tangle becomes a bouquet.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: That spawn just shrank one of the loops. Isn't that the same move?

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: No — that's Null's move. A loop has one end. Shrink it and a hole dies.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Count platforms minus walkways. Felling the tree never changes that number. That number is the Euler characteristic, χ.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Clear the yard. Then we forge the bridge to the Throne.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Timber!

videos.title: The Cylinder Works
videos.plays: Before World 0 · Bonus level (Extension Cord), found off the Assembly Hall
videos.synopsis: A sealed side door in the Assembly Hall opens onto the Cylinder Works, Emmy's oldest experiment. Optional. Emmy frames the homotopy extension property: if you've already decided how the edge moves, you can extend that motion over the whole piece without changing where it starts — and every CW pair lets you.

scenes.title: The side door
scenes.description: Gyroid's Cell-Smith resonates with a small door in the Assembly Hall wall. It slides open on a tall chamber holding a huge translucent cylinder.

scenes.title: Bottom and side
scenes.description: A gold pattern is fixed on the cylinder's floor. A band of gold light travels up one side wall, moving.

scenes.title: Filling in
scenes.description: Emmy starts the machine: the gold light floods the interior cell by cell, matching the floor at the start and the moving band along the side, until the whole cylinder glows.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 24: “World 0 · Bonus — Extension Cord”.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Emmy, this door just answered the gauntlet.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: My first machine. I'd forgotten I sealed it.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The floor is where everything starts. The side band is a motion we've already chosen for the edge.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The question: can you extend that motion through the whole piece, without changing the start?

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: For anything built from cells, yes — one cell at a time. That's the homotopy extension property.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Optional, you said?

videos.title: Into Bouquet Bastion
videos.plays: After castle-0 (The Hollow Throne), before World 1 · Level 1
videos.synopsis: Null escaped the Hollow Throne still insisting a ring is just a point. Gyroid and Emmy follow the re-knit Winding Way into Bouquet Bastion, where two loop districts meet at a single beacon and the Commutator's ribbon patrols keep travel order. Emmy names the goal: a tool that counts loops, so a hole can be proven.

scenes.title: The Way, re-knit
scenes.description: Dawn. A long glowing causeway stretches north from Retract Reef across open sea. Gyroid and Emmy walk it; behind them the Foundry smokes gently.

scenes.title: Two districts, one beacon
scenes.description: The Bastion comes into view from above: two ring-shaped districts, red-lit and violet-lit, meeting at a single amber beacon like a figure-eight.

scenes.title: The patrols
scenes.description: On the causeways, tall guards in loop pauldrons march in strict order: red ring, violet ring, red backwards, violet backwards. Ribbons trail behind them.

scenes.title: The Commutator
scenes.description: On a balcony of the two-loop Keep in the distance, the Commutator watches, fencing blade lowered, then turns away. A violet ribbon of light — Null's trail — leads past the Keep and beyond.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Gyroid steps off the causeway at Wayfall Landing. Title card at 38: “World 1 — Bouquet Bastion” and “Level 1 — Fixed Endpoints”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Winding Way was whole again as far as the next province — and Null's trail ran straight along it.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Bouquet Bastion. Two loop districts, one beacon. Every road here comes home.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Those guards — they always walk the same order. Red, violet, red back, violet back.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The Commutator's patrols. He thinks order is everything. Here he might be right.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Count your loops, courier. You'll find they all come to nothing in the end.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Bending couldn't prove the ring was a ring. Counting loops can. That's what we learn here.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Then let's start counting.

videos.title: Into Chain Delta
videos.plays: After castle-1 (The Commutator's Keep), before World 2 · Level 1
videos.synopsis: The Commutator's patrol is broken, but Null retreats to the sphere, where loops are blind. Gyroid descends into Chain Delta, wetlands of oriented triangles where shared edges cancel and a missing center survives. Set up homology: boundaries, cycles, holes of every dimension. Null's new claim: the torus and S¹ ∨ S¹ ∨ S² are the same place, because their homology matches.

scenes.title: Keep in ruins
scenes.description: Dawn over the Commutator's Keep. Ribbon patrols hang slack from the loop pauldrons of a toppled marshal statue. Gyroid and Emmy stand on a cracked causeway; the figure-eight districts behind them are quiet. Camera starts wide, then eases toward the pair.

scenes.title: Loops go blind
scenes.description: Cut to Count Null on a pale sphere-island in the mid-distance. He sketches a loop on its surface with a violet fingertip; the loop shrinks smoothly to a point and winks out. He smiles. A second loop does the same. The camera orbits so the sphere reads as hollow yet loop-blind — every drawn path dies.

scenes.title: Descent into the delta
scenes.description: Gyroid and Emmy leave the keep and descend a switchback of glowing causeways into Chain Delta: an annular wetland of triangular platforms floating over dark water, with a conspicuously empty hole at the center. Camera flies ahead, then tilts down through mist to the tiles. Amber edge-arrows mark orientation on each face.

scenes.title: Edges that cancel
scenes.description: Close over two adjacent triangles sharing an interior edge. Emmy flips their orientation glyphs; the shared edge lights red on one face and cyan on the other, then both cancel into quiet. The outer ring of edges stays lit. Gyroid steps onto a surviving cycle that runs around the missing center — the path cannot be filled in.

scenes.title: Null's new count
scenes.description: Wide split composition: left, a torus island with two belt roads and a hollow interior; right, a bouquet of two circles wedged to a sphere, lit to silhouette-match the torus at a glance. Null stands between them on a black spit of land. He raises the Crown; both islands flash the same three violet tally marks (H₀, H₁×H₁, H₂). He gestures as if they were identical papers.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Pull back over the whole delta, missing center still dark water. Title card fades in at 39: “Winding World — Cycles remember what loops forget.” and “World 2 · Level 1 — Tile and Error”. Fade to black at 48.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Commutator's ribbons went slack. Bouquet Bastion could keep its noncommuting routes — for now.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: He ran. Toward the sphere.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Draw any loop you like. Watch it shrink. There is nothing here to save.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Loops had been their sharpest tool. On a sphere, that tool goes blind.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Then we stop counting paths — and start counting what they enclose. Down into the delta.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Chain Delta: wetlands tiled with oriented triangles, and a hole at the heart that refuses to fill.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Shared edges cancel. Face plus face — the seam disappears. That's a boundary.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: But this ring around the missing center… nothing tiles it shut. It cycles. It stays.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: A torus. A wedge of two circles and a sphere. Different costumes — same census.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: If the counts agree, the places agree. I have already simplified them.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Homology would teach Gyroid to hear holes loops cannot feel — and, later, to catch the lie in Null's twin tally.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Tile carefully. Glue by the arrows. If the edges don't match, the land won't hold.

videos.title: Into the Cup Product Gardens
videos.plays: After castle-2 (The Retractor), before World 3 · Level 1
videos.synopsis: Null's ball-to-boundary retractor failed (H₂(B³) = 0 — Brouwer one dimension up). The Commutator shows up in disguise at a counterfeit station that matches the torus group for group. Gyroid enters the signal gardens, where cochains read chains backwards and classes multiply. Null's new claim: every map S³ → S² is trivial.

scenes.title: The garden stair
scenes.description: Gyroid and Emmy climb from the delta's canals up a garden stair; lantern posts line the paths ahead.

scenes.title: Reading backwards
scenes.description: In a still pool, the garden path is reflected with its arrows reversed; values glow on its edges.

scenes.title: Lanterns multiply
scenes.description: Two lanterns' beams cross and a third, brighter lantern lights where they meet.

scenes.title: Null's new claim
scenes.description: At the edge of the gardens, Null holds a small 3-sphere of light in one hand and a 2-sphere in the other; he crushes a map between them to nothing. Far off, a station with a torus façade, a masked station master on its platform.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 36: “World 3 — Cup Product Gardens” and “Level 1 — Reverse Engineering”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Beyond the delta lay gardens where no one walked the paths — they read them.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: A reading gives every edge a value. Read a triangle by its edges, and we see holes from the other side.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Two lanterns made a third. Readings multiply?

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: And that's what Null's two islands can't fake.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: A three-sphere onto a two-sphere — your meters see nothing. Every such map is trivial.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: And who's the station master? He stands like a fencer.

videos.title: Up the Postnikov Spire
videos.plays: After castle-3 (The Counterfeit Station), before World 4 · Level 1
videos.synopsis: Unmasked by a nonzero cup product, the Commutator's station falls and Null retreats up his tower into higher homotopy. The ascent: rooms that unfold into higher dimensions, the Null Crown waiting at the top. Null's final claim: give him the homotopy groups and he can rebuild any space — the twists don't matter.

scenes.title: The Spire
scenes.description: Gyroid and Emmy at the foot of a tower rising into the clouds; the seam of Poincaré Reach ends at its door.

scenes.title: Rooms that unfold
scenes.description: The camera rises past floors: cubes opening into cubes, spheres wrapping spheres, a ring of linked circles.

scenes.title: The Crown
scenes.description: At the top, the Null Crown pulses; through it, the whole Winding Way seen far below, slowly drawn inward.

scenes.title: Null's claim
scenes.description: Null drops glowing brackets from the Crown; they tumble away into the clouds.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 38: “World 4 — Postnikov Spire” and “Level 1 — Cube Root”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The last province was not land at all, but a tower — and every floor had more dimensions than the last.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Up here, loops become spheres. Holes of every dimension, wrapping each other.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: He's pulling the whole Winding Way in. Everything we restored.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Give me the groups and I'll rebuild any space. These twists? Ornament.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Those twists hold the tower together. Let's go up and prove it.

videos.title: The Crown Unwound
videos.plays: After castle-4 (The Null Crown) — the game is won
videos.synopsis: Gyroid rebuilds the Crown's tower stage by stage, installing the k-invariants Null threw away, and disconnects its collapse drive. The ringed island returns — hole and all — and every province is restored without erasing a single hole. Callback to the opening: shape changed, topology didn't. Null is not destroyed but reshaped, and Emmy's last line names the theme. Credits carry Hatcher's Algebraic Topology attribution.

scenes.title: Rebuilt
scenes.description: The last gold bracket clicks into place; the Crown's points straighten; its collapse drive gutters out.

scenes.title: Null, reshaped
scenes.description: Null's cloak unravels into a ring of violet light around him; he is smaller, unmasked, holding a small torus in his hands and staring at its hole.

scenes.title: The Way returns
scenes.description: From the Spire's top, the camera sweeps down over every province expanding back: Retract Reef, Bouquet Bastion's two districts, Chain Delta's empty middle, the Gardens' lanterns, the Reach's seam.

scenes.title: The Ringed Isle
scenes.description: Back at Retract Reef: the Ringed Isle rises from the sea, hole and all, exactly as in the opening — but now Callimachus's library lanterns line its rim. Gyroid, Emmy and the Commutator stand on it.

scenes.title: Last line
scenes.description: Gyroid coils his lasso into a loop around his arm; Emmy looks out at the restored Way.

scenes.title: Credits
scenes.description: Title card at 52: “Winding World” — “Based on Algebraic Topology by Allen Hatcher (Cambridge University Press, 2002)”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Every twist back where it belongs. The tower stands.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: I only wanted it simple. A point is so… simple.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Keep the torus. Look at its hole for a while. It's not going anywhere.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Winding Way unrolled, province by province — every shape a little different, every hole exactly where it had been.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The ring's back. Same hole. We never had to erase anything.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: In order, I hope.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Shapes change, Gyroid. What can't be undone is what makes them themselves.

videos.title: The Hollow Throne
videos.plays: Before castle-0, after crossing the forged bridge from the Timber Yard
videos.synopsis: Gyroid crosses the bridge forged at the Timber Yard and climbs the black spire. In the throne room Null waits under the Crown, amused that a courier has come to argue shapes with him. He promises three trials.

scenes.title: The bridge
scenes.description: Gyroid runs across the newly forged gold-seamed bridge toward the black spire; the Foundry glows behind. Emmy stays at the bridgehead.

scenes.title: The climb
scenes.description: A spiral stair of black glass around the spire's outside; the world falls away below.

scenes.title: The throne room
scenes.description: A circular hall with open arches. The reef-tile floor ripples. Null stands before an empty throne, the Crown floating overhead.

scenes.title: Three trials
scenes.description: Null gestures; three violet sigils light in the floor. Crown shards begin to orbit.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 30: “World 0 · Castle — The Hollow Throne”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The bridge holds. Go — I'll keep the Foundry lit behind you.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Hollow Throne: a spire of black glass, and at its top, the one who started the collapse.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: The courier who keeps holes. You've learned to bend my reef without breaking it. Impressive.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: But bending is cheap. Can you tell a true simplification from a false one?

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Three trials. Fail one, and your precious reef becomes a point.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Then I won't fail.

videos.title: A Ring Is a Ring
videos.plays: After castle-0's final phase — the end of World 0
videos.synopsis: Gyroid has exposed every forgery. Null holds up a ring and calls it a point; Gyroid can't prove otherwise. Null escapes along the severed Winding Way toward Bouquet Bastion. Emmy names what they need: an invariant.

scenes.title: The last claim
scenes.description: The arena still. Null lifts a glowing ring between two fingers.

scenes.title: No proof
scenes.description: Gyroid tries to slide the ring to a point on the arena floor; every slide stops short of the hole. He can't make it shrink — but he can't show it never could.

scenes.title: Escape
scenes.description: Null steps backwards off the spire's edge onto a violet ribbon of light that races away north along the broken Way.

scenes.title: Emmy
scenes.description: At the bridgehead at dawn, Emmy and Gyroid look north: the Way's next stretch leads to two loop districts meeting at a beacon.

scenes.title: World 0 complete
scenes.description: Card: “World 0 complete — Retract Reef restored.” Then the World 1 map unfolds.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Every trick of mine, exposed. Well done. Now — this ring.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: It is a point. Prove it isn't.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Every slide I try stops at the hole. It won't shrink.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Won't — or can't? You don't know. Nobody here knows.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: And with that, Null stepped off the spire and was gone up the broken Winding Way.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: He's right about one thing. Bending can't prove a hole is there. We need something that counts it.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Then we follow him, and find it.

videos.title: The Couriers' Ledger
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Level 1, entering Endpoint Gardens
videos.synopsis: Bastion couriers keep a ledger of routes between gatehouses. Emmy explains: two routes are the same delivery if one slides into the other with both ends held at their gates.

scenes.title: The gardens
scenes.description: Hedged lawns between two gatehouses; a gardener-courier's ledger lies open on a lectern with glowing route sketches (no text).

scenes.title: Same delivery
scenes.description: Two gold routes across an open lawn; one slides onto the other while the ends stay pinned at the gates.

scenes.title: The hedge
scenes.description: A route around the left of a hedge bed and one around the right; they slide toward each other and stop at the hedge.

scenes.title: Snappers
scenes.description: Violet crabs scuttle out to clip the threads.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 1 · Level 1 — Fixed Endpoints”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: In Bouquet Bastion, couriers kept a ledger — not of parcels, but of routes.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Two routes are the same delivery if one slides into the other — and both ends stay at their gates the whole time.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Left of the hedge and right of the hedge won't slide together.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Not by any slide we can find. Sort them, and keep that hedge in mind.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Snappers. Of course.

videos.title: Every Road Comes Home
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Level 2, at the Basepoint Beacon
videos.synopsis: At the beacon, routes that return home become loops, and loops combine, undo and compare. The Lash learns to close loops.

scenes.title: The beacon
scenes.description: The amber beacon towers where the two districts meet; its light pulses each time someone returns.

scenes.title: Loop Lash
scenes.description: Emmy taps Gyroid's lasso; its gold cord now closes into a ring as he spins it.

scenes.title: There and back
scenes.description: Gyroid runs a loop out and back, then runs it backwards; the two trails pull together into nothing at the beacon's foot.

scenes.title: Scouts
scenes.description: A ribbon patrol watches from a bridge, then withdraws in strict order.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 1 · Level 2 — Loop de Loop”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: A route that leaves the beacon and comes back is a loop. Loops are what we'll count.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Your Lash can close them now. Every loop you run, it remembers.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Out and back, then the same loop backwards… it all slides down to standing still.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Every loop has an undo. That's what makes them a group.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: We're being watched.

videos.title: The Winding Road
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Level 3
videos.synopsis: Above a ring island rises a helix: each lap below is a turn up the ramp above. The floor Gyroid's shadow ends on can't be changed by sliding — winding numbers are integers.

scenes.title: The helix
scenes.description: A round ring island; above it, a stone helix ramp spirals into the clouds.

scenes.title: The shadow climbs
scenes.description: Gyroid jogs around the ring; a luminous copy of him climbs the helix in step. One lap, one floor.

scenes.title: Wiggle
scenes.description: Gyroid weaves a wild path around the ring; the shadow wobbles but ends on the same floor.

scenes.title: Winders
scenes.description: Violet coils wrap around pillars two and three times.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 28: “World 1 · Level 3 — Winding Road”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Above the ring rose a road that never stopped climbing.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Each lap down here is one turn up there. Your Winding Cord reads the floor.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: However I wiggle, I end up on the same floor.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Sliding can't change it. That number belongs to the loop.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Winders. Unwind them first — then lash.

videos.title: No Way Out
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Level 4, at Brouwer's Basin
videos.synopsis: Null's Retractor tries to squash Brouwer's Basin onto its rim. With the Winding Cord, Gyroid can prove it impossible — and finally answer Null's claim that a ring is a point.

scenes.title: The basin
scenes.description: A vast round basin; the Retractor engine strains at its center, chains hooked to the rim road.

scenes.title: Null's boast
scenes.description: Null's image flickers over the engine.

scenes.title: The proof
scenes.description: Gyroid runs the rim: the cord reads one floor. He shrinks the loop inside the basin to nothing; the engine would have to turn that nothing back into one lap on the rim. Gears grind and seize.

scenes.title: Still points
scenes.description: Gold arrows on the basin tiles swirl toward one still tile.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 30: “World 1 · Level 4 — No Way Out”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Null's Retractor had one job: squash the whole basin onto its rim.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: A basin is just its edge with filling. Squeeze out the filling.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The rim loop winds once. In the basin it shrinks to nothing.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: So the Retractor would have to turn nothing back into one lap. It can't. And that settles the ring, too.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: A ring winds once. A point winds zero. They were never the same.

videos.title: Two Roads
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Level 5, at the Torus Terraces
videos.synopsis: On the Torus Terraces two belt roads give two independent loops; projectors push loops between islands. On a torus, one-then-the-other equals the-other-then-one.

scenes.title: The terraces
scenes.description: A torus-shaped terraced island; one gold road wraps the tube, another runs through the hole.

scenes.title: The projector
scenes.description: A brass projector beams a loop from one island onto another; the projected loop winds twice.

scenes.title: The grid
scenes.description: A translucent square grid unrolls above the torus; Gyroid's shadow walks it, tube-then-hole and hole-then-tube reaching the same corner.

scenes.title: Imps
scenes.description: A violet imp hijacks a projector.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 1 · Level 5 — Push It Forward”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Two roads: one around the tube, one through the hole. Two kinds of loop.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The projector maps my loop onto that island — and it winds twice there.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: On a torus, a loop needs two numbers. And the order you walk the roads doesn't matter.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Tube then hole, hole then tube — same corner of the grid.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Hey — get off that projector!

videos.title: Laps Are Letters
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Level 6, at the Free-Word Forge
videos.synopsis: In the two loop districts every lap writes a letter. Opposites cancel; nothing else does. The Commutator's patrol word a b a⁻¹ b⁻¹ never cancels. Gyroid forges the Van Kampen Clasp.

scenes.title: Red and violet
scenes.description: The red and violet districts meet at the beacon; a bead tape hovers over Gyroid.

scenes.title: Writing
scenes.description: Gyroid laps red, then violet backwards: beads appear. A red lap then a red lap backwards: the pair snaps off.

scenes.title: The patrol word
scenes.description: A ribbon patrol marches red, violet, red back, violet back; its tape never shrinks.

scenes.title: The Clasp
scenes.description: Emmy forges a copper clasp joining red and violet cords at an amber bead.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 28: “World 1 · Level 6 — Free Word Play”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Here, every lap left a mark — a letter in a word only the loop could spell.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Red is a, violet is b. Backwards is the inverse. Opposites side by side cancel.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The patrol walks a, b, a back, b back. Nothing cancels.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: And here, nothing ever will. Order matters in a bouquet.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Take the Clasp. It keeps your letters in order.

videos.title: Glue Job
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Level 7, at the Glue Works
videos.synopsis: Glue a disk onto a loop and that loop vanishes. Glue along a b a⁻¹ b⁻¹ and the bouquet becomes a torus — the patrol word dies.

scenes.title: The Works
scenes.description: Presses hang over the loop districts; translucent gold disks wait in racks.

scenes.title: One disk
scenes.description: A disk is pressed onto a single loop; Gyroid's loop slides across it and vanishes.

scenes.title: The commutator disk
scenes.description: Emmy walks the patrol word; the press glues a disk along it; the bouquet folds into a torus.

scenes.title: Unglue
scenes.description: Violet sprites tug at the disk's edge.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 1 · Level 7 — Glue Job”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Glue a disk onto a loop, and the loop can slide across it and vanish.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: So a disk is a way to make a word mean nothing.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Glue one along a, b, a back, b back — the bouquet becomes a torus. Now a then b is b then a.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The Commutator's word just died.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Unless they unglue it.

videos.title: Under Cover
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Level 8, at the Sheetwater Viaduct
videos.synopsis: Three glass sheets copy the figure-eight; each step below moves a lift above. A loop can end on another sheet. Emmy is stranded on sheet two — and the Sheet Compass will prove a b ≠ b a.

scenes.title: The viaduct
scenes.description: Three glass sheets stacked over the figure-eight causeway, ports glowing at every junction.

scenes.title: Stranded
scenes.description: A sheet shifts and Emmy is carried up to sheet two, out of reach.

scenes.title: The Compass
scenes.description: Gyroid picks up a glowing compass; as he walks below, a luminous lift of him walks the sheets, changing sheet at certain ports.

scenes.title: Liftlings
scenes.description: Violet sprites appear on single sheets.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 30: “World 1 · Level 8 — Under Cover”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Above the figure-eight hung three glass copies of it — and every step below echoed above.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Gyroid! The sheet moved — I'm on sheet two. Find a route that lifts to me!

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The Compass shows my lift. A loop down here can end on a different sheet up there.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Then build me a cover where a then b closes and b then a doesn't — and you've proved they differ.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Hold on. I'm coming up.

videos.title: Sheet Music
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Level 9, at the Sheet Stacks
videos.synopsis: The Stacks build covers to order — any choice of which loops close. The endless cover is a tree; over a torus it's a plane.

scenes.title: The Stacks
scenes.description: Towers of glass sheets of every height; a sentinel guards each tower's start.

scenes.title: An order
scenes.description: Emmy reads an order off a slate (no text visible): a loop that must close twice but not once; a two-sheet tower rises.

scenes.title: The endless tree
scenes.description: A branching viaduct recedes forever into fog; Gyroid's lift wanders it and never returns to the same vertex unless he retraces.

scenes.title: The plane
scenes.description: An endless grid shimmers over a torus island.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 1 · Level 9 — Sheet Music”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Tell the Stacks which loops should close, and they'll build you a cover for it.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Twice around closes, once doesn't — two sheets.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: And if nothing should close at all, you get the endless tree. Every word ends somewhere new.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: It goes on forever.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: So does the plane over a torus.

videos.title: Deck the Halls
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Level 10, in the Deck Halls
videos.synopsis: Some covers are symmetric: shift every sheet at once and nothing changes. A sphere where opposite doors open into the same room covers the projective plane.

scenes.title: The halls
scenes.description: Vaulted glass halls; three stacked floors rotate in unison like a carousel.

scenes.title: A shift
scenes.description: Gyroid turns a great wheel; every floor shifts one place and every port still lines up.

scenes.title: The sphere hall
scenes.description: A round hall with paired golden doors exactly opposite each other; Gyroid walks through one and out its opposite.

scenes.title: Deck guards
scenes.description: Identical violet guards appear on every floor at once.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 1 · Level 10 — Deck the Halls”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: In the Deck Halls, whole floors moved together — and nothing changed.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: A shift that keeps every edge matched is a symmetry of the cover. They form a group too.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Opposite doors, same room. This sphere is folded in half.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The sphere covers the projective plane, twice. Every point down there is two points up here.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: One lash, every floor.

videos.title: Free Agents
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Bonus 1, in Free Agents' Grove
videos.synopsis: A cover of a graph is a graph: fell its tree and count petals. Every subgroup of a free group is free.

scenes.title: The grove
scenes.description: Glass trees whose branches are covering graphs.

scenes.title: Felling
scenes.description: Gyroid marks a tree in amber on a two-sheet cover and fells it; three petals remain.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 18: “World 1 · Bonus — Free Agents”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Remember the Timber Yard? A cover of a graph is still a graph.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Fell the tree… three petals. Two sheets, three petals.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Every subgroup of a free group is free. And now you can count its generators.

videos.title: One Group to Rule
videos.plays: Before World 1 · Bonus 2, at the One-Group Tower
videos.synopsis: Some places are entirely described by their loops: their universal cover shrinks to a point. The tower collects them.

scenes.title: The tower
scenes.description: A glass tower; each floor shows an endless tree or plane below.

scenes.title: Shrinking above
scenes.description: On each floor, the endless cover visibly shrinks to a point.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 18: “World 1 · Bonus — One Group to Rule”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Every floor here has an endless cover that shrinks to a point.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: So nothing above loops matters. The loops are the whole story.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: One group, one space. Mathematicians call them K of G, one.

videos.title: The Commutator's Keep
videos.plays: Before castle-1
videos.synopsis: The Keep's door hangs on the Viaduct's second sheet. Inside, the Commutator salutes with his blade and starts his patrol.

scenes.title: The door on sheet two
scenes.description: Gyroid's lift climbs to the second sheet; a door in mid-air opens into the two-loop Keep.

scenes.title: The arena
scenes.description: A figure-eight arena under stacked glass sheets; crimson and violet ribbons hang from the vaults.

scenes.title: The marshal
scenes.description: The Commutator steps down, pauldrons blazing, and salutes with his fencing blade.

scenes.title: En garde
scenes.description: He dashes the first lap of his word; four ribbons stream behind him.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 30: “World 1 · Castle — The Commutator's Keep”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Keep's door hung on the second sheet — reachable only by a courier who could lift.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: Order, courier. A, then b, then back, then back. Undo me if you can.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: In this arena? Your word doesn't cancel. I'll have to prove it.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: Prove it at the point of my blade.

videos.title: Loops Go Blind
videos.plays: After castle-1 — the end of World 1
videos.synopsis: With the arena glued into a torus, the Commutator's word slides to nothing and he yields, retreating. Null appears on a pale sphere-island and shows every loop shrinking: loops can't see a sphere's hollow.

scenes.title: The word dies
scenes.description: The arena folds into a torus; the Commutator's ribbons slacken and fall.

scenes.title: Retreat
scenes.description: The Commutator bows stiffly and vanishes into a ribbon of violet light.

scenes.title: The sphere
scenes.description: Far off, Null stands on a pale sphere-island, drawing loops that shrink to points one after another.

scenes.title: Emmy
scenes.description: Emmy looks at the sphere through her goggles.

scenes.title: World 1 complete
scenes.description: Card: “World 1 complete — Bouquet Bastion restored.”

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: On a torus, your word means nothing, marshal.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: Order isn't everything, then. Noted. We will meet again.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Draw a loop on my sphere. Watch it shrink. There is nothing here for your counting to find.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Every loop shrinks… but the sphere's hollow. I can feel it.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Loops can't see it. We need to count what they enclose. That means the Delta.

videos.title: Three Corners
videos.plays: Before World 2 · Level 1, in the Tile Yard
videos.synopsis: In the Tile Yard, places are built from triangles with arrowed edges. Two triangles become a torus, a Klein bottle or a projective plane depending on the arrows.

scenes.title: The yard
scenes.description: Stacks of triangle platforms, amber arrows on their edges, a brass crane.

scenes.title: Two make a square
scenes.description: The crane lowers two triangles together into a square.

scenes.title: Fold
scenes.description: The square's matching edges curl together: a torus forms. Emmy flips one arrow; the shape twists into a Klein bottle.

scenes.title: Flippers
scenes.description: Violet frogs hop onto edges.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 2 · Level 1 — Tile and Error”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: To count holes of every size, we need places built from pieces we can count.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Triangles, with arrows. Edges glue only when the arrows agree.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Two triangles… and it's a torus.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Flip one arrow and it's a Klein bottle. Same pieces, different gluing.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Keep those frogs off my arrows.

videos.title: The Boundary Blade
videos.plays: Before World 2 · Level 2, in Cancel Marsh
videos.synopsis: Emmy forges the Boundary Blade. Cut a patch and shared edges cancel; cut a boundary and nothing is left. A cycle that bounds nothing is a hole.

scenes.title: The forge
scenes.description: Emmy hammers a gold blade of light on a portable anvil at the marsh edge.

scenes.title: First cut
scenes.description: Gyroid strikes a plaza of triangles: inner arrows cancel in sparks, an outline glows.

scenes.title: Nothing left
scenes.description: He strikes the outline: the blade passes through with no mark.

scenes.title: The gap
scenes.description: A ring of tiles around a missing one; the inner loop glows and won't go out.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 28: “World 2 · Level 2 — Boundary Issues”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: My namesake. The Boundary Blade cuts anything down to its edge.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The inside edges cancel — one arrow each way.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Cut the edge again and… nothing.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: An edge has no edge. Always.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: But a loop that isn't the edge of anything — that's a hole.

videos.title: Any Simplex Will Do
videos.plays: Before World 2 · Level 3, in the Singular Shallows
videos.synopsis: Real places don't come in tidy triangles. Crumpled triangles work too, and places that deform into each other read the same.

scenes.title: Fog
scenes.description: Misty shallows; no tidy tiles anywhere.

scenes.title: Crumpled
scenes.description: Gyroid stamps a triangle that folds like cloth onto the water; the blade still traces its edges.

scenes.title: Same count
scenes.description: A fat annulus slides down to a thin circle; the abacus beads don't move.

scenes.title: Crumplers
scenes.description: Violet wads tumble through the mist.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 2 · Level 3 — Any Simplex Will Do”.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: No tiles here. How do we count?

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Any triangle will do — bent, folded, squashed flat. The blade still cuts it.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: And deforming the place doesn't change the count.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Same shape in the Mirror Shoals' sense, same holes.

videos.title: Chase Scene
videos.plays: Before World 2 · Level 4, in the Chase Channels
videos.synopsis: Canal locks pass water exactly from one to the next. Gyroid learns to chase a drop through the grid and read a place's holes from a pair.

scenes.title: The locks
scenes.description: Rows of canal locks glowing amber, sluices between them.

scenes.title: Exact
scenes.description: Water leaves one lock and exactly fills the drain of the next.

scenes.title: The chase
scenes.description: Gyroid follows a gold drop down, across, and up the grid, arriving at a lock no sluice seemed to reach.

scenes.title: Leaks
scenes.description: A violet sprite punctures a lock.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 2 · Level 4 — Chase Scene”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: In the Chase Channels, nothing was lost between one lock and the next.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: What one sluice sends is exactly what the next one drains. That's exact.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Down, across, back up — the drop found a new route.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: That route links a place's holes to a part's holes. Chase it.

videos.title: Cut and Paste
videos.plays: Before World 2 · Level 5, at the Excision Cut
videos.synopsis: Excise deep inside a part and the relative count holds; collapse a part and it becomes ordinary homology. Climb the sphere ladder.

scenes.title: The quarry
scenes.description: The far bank's quarry; saws and a great press.

scenes.title: Cut deep
scenes.description: A saw removes a block deep inside a marked region; the meter doesn't flinch.

scenes.title: The ladder
scenes.description: The press squashes a disk's rim to a point, making a sphere; spheres stack up a ladder, each with one glowing hole.

scenes.title: Golem
scenes.description: A violet stone golem lumbers out.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 28: “World 2 · Level 5 — Cut and Paste”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Cut out what's deep inside the part, and nothing about the pair changes.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Squash the rim to a point — that's the Cone Zone trick.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: And a disk with its rim squashed is a sphere. Climb, and every sphere has exactly one hole.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: One hole, in its own dimension. Null's sphere included.

videos.title: The Third Degree
videos.plays: Before World 2 · Level 6, at the Dynamo Gate
videos.synopsis: Gyroid measures Null's sphere and the hollow is seen. At the Degree Dynamo, maps of spheres wrap a whole number of times — and no wind can cover a sphere without a calm spot.

scenes.title: The hollow
scenes.description: Gyroid points the meter at Null's pale sphere far off; one bead slides into the second row.

scenes.title: Null hears
scenes.description: Null's image flickers, irritated.

scenes.title: The Dynamo
scenes.description: Great brass spheres wrap skins around each other, once, twice, inside-out.

scenes.title: The calm spot
scenes.description: Wind arrows swirl across a sphere island, all but one point.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 30: “World 2 · Level 6 — The Third Degree”.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Loops couldn't see it. The meter can. Your sphere has a hole, Null.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: A number on a dial. Spin it however you like.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The Degree Dial counts how many times one sphere wraps another.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Inside-out counts as minus one.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: And wind can't cover a sphere without a calm spot. Try it.

videos.title: Cell Block
videos.plays: Before World 2 · Level 7
videos.synopsis: Build a place from cells and its holes come from the cells alone. A doubled edge makes a loop that dies when doubled: torsion.

scenes.title: Crates
scenes.description: Glowing crates stacked by dimension; arrows between stacks.

scenes.title: Torus
scenes.description: Torus crates: every arrow reads zero, every crate survives.

scenes.title: Doubled
scenes.description: A disk's rim wraps twice around a loop; the loop glows half-bright.

scenes.title: Census
scenes.description: The Timber Yard census board lights.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 2 · Level 7 — Cell Block”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Built cell by cell, a place gives up its holes with almost no work.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The arrows are just degrees. The Dial reads them.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The projective plane's disk wraps its edge twice. Go around twice and it's filled.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Once, it's a hole. Twice, it's not. Weird.

videos.title: Patchwork

videos.synopsis: Cover a place with two overlapping patches; their holes and the overlap's link up — Mayer–Vietoris, Van Kampen's cousin.

scenes.title: The fields
scenes.description: Canvas patches over rolling hills.

scenes.title: Two caps
scenes.description: Two caps cover a sphere-hill, overlapping in a band; the seam glows.

scenes.title: Clasp
scenes.description: Gyroid clips patches together with the Clasp.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 24: “World 2 · Level 8 — Patchwork”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Two patches and their overlap tell you the whole place's holes.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Like Van Kampen at the Glue Works — but for holes.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Mind the overlap. That's where the surprises are.

videos.title: Mod Squad
videos.plays: Before World 2 · Level 9
videos.synopsis: Count holes mod 2 and arrows stop mattering — the top hole of a non-orientable surface appears.

scenes.title: The mill
scenes.description: A waterwheel turns; Emmy throws a lever.

scenes.title: Even or odd
scenes.description: The Klein bottle in the pond lights from inside.

scenes.title: Frogs
scenes.description: A Flipper flips an arrow; nothing happens. It looks confused.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 24: “World 2 · Level 9 — Mod Squad”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Count even or odd instead of whole numbers.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The Klein bottle lit up! It had a hole the whole time?

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Its top hole only shows when arrows don't matter. It has no consistent arrows.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Sorry, frog. Flipping does nothing here.

videos.title: Forget the Order
videos.plays: Before World 2 · Level 10, at the Abelian Ford
videos.synopsis: The Commutator's patrols follow Gyroid into the delta, but in homology order is forgotten and their word counts as nothing.

scenes.title: The ford
scenes.description: Ribbon patrols arrive at a shallow ford.

scenes.title: Dissolve
scenes.description: The first guard steps in, walking a, b, a back, b back; its ribbons dissolve into ripples.

scenes.title: The marshal
scenes.description: The Commutator watches from the far bank, then withdraws.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 2 · Level 10 — Forget the Order”.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The Commutator's patrols followed us.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Here only totals count. a, b, a back, b back totals nothing.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: So your counting forgets order. I'll remember that.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: That sounded like a threat.

videos.title: Classic Moves
videos.plays: Before World 2 · Bonus 1, at the Jordan Ring
videos.synopsis: Any closed wall splits the plane into inside and outside — proved with homology.

scenes.title: The wall
scenes.description: A wiggly wall circles an island.

scenes.title: Inside
scenes.description: The inside lights gold, the outside stays dark.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 16: “World 2 · Bonus — Classic Moves”.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Obviously a wall has an inside.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Obvious, and famously hard to prove. Now we have the tools.

videos.title: Fixed Ideas

videos.synopsis: Add up traces on homology; if the total isn't zero, the lantern's map has a fixed point.

scenes.title: The lantern

scenes.title: The still spot
scenes.description: The beam rests on one arrow-free spot.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 16: “World 2 · Bonus — Fixed Ideas”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Brouwer's Basin, grown up: add the traces, find the still point.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Not zero — so somewhere, the beam lands where it started.

videos.title: The Retractor, Again
videos.plays: Before castle-2
videos.synopsis: Null has rebuilt his Retractor one dimension up: crush a solid ball onto its sphere skin.

scenes.title: The dome
scenes.description: A stone dome around a hollow ball; violet chains strain at its surface.

scenes.title: Null
scenes.description: Null stands atop the machine, Crown glowing.

scenes.title: Ready
scenes.description: Gyroid raises the Dial; Emmy the meter.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 28: “World 2 · Castle — The Retractor”.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Null had learned nothing from the Basin — only to build bigger.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: A ball is just its skin, stuffed. I'll squeeze out the stuffing.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Same trick as the Basin. The skin has a hole; the ball doesn't.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: So the engine would have to make a hole out of nothing. Let's watch it try.

videos.title: Classes Multiply
videos.plays: After castle-2 — the end of World 2
videos.synopsis: The Retractor seizes. Null escapes toward the gardens, laughing that the torus and a bouquet with a sphere attached have the same holes. Emmy realizes they need a sharper instrument: holes that multiply.

scenes.title: Seize
scenes.description: The engine's gears grind and lock; chains go slack.

scenes.title: Two islands
scenes.description: Null, escaping, conjures a torus island and a two-loops-plus-sphere island side by side; the meter reads the same on both.

scenes.title: The gardens
scenes.description: Beyond, signal gardens glow with lanterns that light in pairs.

scenes.title: World 2 complete
scenes.description: Card: “World 2 complete — Chain Delta restored.”

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: It's seized. A hole can't come from nothing.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Count these, then. Same holes, every dimension. Same place.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The meter agrees with him… but they can't be the same.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Counting holes isn't enough. We need to know how they multiply. To the Gardens.

videos.title: Reverse Engineering
videos.plays: Before World 3 · Level 1, at the Mirror Pools
videos.synopsis: Cochains read chains: values on edges, triangles read through their edges. The pools show boundaries as coboundaries.

scenes.title: The pools
scenes.description: Mirror pools beside garden paths.

scenes.title: Readings
scenes.description: Gyroid sets gold values on edges with a wand.

scenes.title: Around the hole
scenes.description: On an annular path, a reading glows 1 around the inner rim and won't come from vertex values.

scenes.title: Echoes
scenes.description: A violet reflection moves in a pool on its own.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 3 · Level 1 — Reverse Engineering”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: In the delta we cut things to their edges. Here we read them.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Give every edge a value — the pool reads the triangles for me.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: A reading that's balanced everywhere but can't come from points sees a hole.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: My reflection just waved.

videos.title: Torsion Shift
videos.plays: Before World 3 · Level 2
videos.synopsis: Readings are determined by holes — except twisted holes climb one terrace up.

scenes.title: The terrace
scenes.description: Stone terraces; vines climb between them.

scenes.title: The vine climbs
scenes.description: The projective plane's twisted loop vine climbs from terrace 1 to terrace 2.

scenes.title: Choker
scenes.description: A violet vine wraps one and pulls.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 24: “World 3 · Level 2 — Torsion Shift”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Readings mostly match the holes we counted in the delta. Mostly.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The doubled loop from Cell Block — it climbed a terrace.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Twisted holes show up one floor higher in readings. Plan for it.

videos.title: Front Face, Back Face
videos.plays: Before World 3 · Level 3, in the Lantern Rows
videos.synopsis: Emmy forges the Cup Caster: read the front edge with one reading and the back edge with another, and readings multiply.

scenes.title: The rows
scenes.description: Rows of lantern posts, two lit.

scenes.title: The Caster
scenes.description: Emmy hands Gyroid a gold chalice; he holds it up between the two lanterns and their beams pour in.

scenes.title: A third light
scenes.description: A third lantern lights. He swaps the order; it flickers inverted.

scenes.title: Moths
scenes.description: Violet moths descend on the lanterns.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 3 · Level 3 — Front Face, Back Face”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Read a triangle's front edge with one reading and its back edge with another.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The Cup Caster does it for you. Two readings in, one out.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Swap the order and the light flips.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: For two loop readings, yes. Signs matter here.

videos.title: A Cup of Counterexample
videos.plays: Before World 3 · Level 4, at the Twin Islands
videos.synopsis: Null's torus and bouquet-with-sphere share every hole count. The Cup Caster lights the top class on one and not the other.

scenes.title: Twins
scenes.description: The two islands side by side; the meter shows identical beads.

scenes.title: Cast on the torus

scenes.title: Cast on the bouquet
scenes.description: The beams pass each other on separate rings; the dome stays dark.

scenes.title: Watched
scenes.description: The Commutator, in a boat offshore, rows away.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 28: “World 3 · Level 4 — A Cup of Counterexample”.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Null's twins. Same holes in every dimension.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: On the torus, the two loop readings multiply to the top.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: On the bouquet, they never meet. Nothing lights.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Different products, different places. Null was wrong.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: That boatman again. Same fencer's stance.

videos.title: Product Placement

videos.synopsis: In the Parterre, rows times columns: a product's readings come from its factors.

scenes.title: The grid

scenes.title: Crossings
scenes.description: Beams along a row and a column meet in a bed and light it.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 22: “World 3 · Level 5 — Product Placement”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: A product of places has products of readings. Rows times columns.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Circle times circle — that's the Torus Terraces.

videos.title: Polynomial Garden
videos.plays: Before World 3 · Level 6
videos.synopsis: On projective spaces one lantern's powers light the whole garden — then stop. Borsuk–Ulam follows.

scenes.title: The fountain
scenes.description: Tiers of lantern rings rising like a fountain.

scenes.title: Powers
scenes.description: Gyroid casts a lantern with itself; tier after tier lights to the crown, then the next cast fizzles.

scenes.title: Antipodes
scenes.description: A sphere island's opposite stations glow in matching colors.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 24: “World 3 · Level 6 — Polynomial Garden”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: In this garden, one lantern makes all the others.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Square, cube… right to the top. And then nothing.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: That stopping point is why two opposite stations must always match.

videos.title: Which Way Is Up
videos.plays: Before World 3 · Level 7, at the Compass Cliffs

scenes.description: First view of Poincaré Reach: cliffs, a glowing seam far off.

scenes.title: Compasses

scenes.title: Two sheets
scenes.description: The Sheet Compass shows two sheets over the cliff, joined into one strip.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 3 · Level 7 — Which Way Is Up”.

captions.text: Past the gardens, the coast began to mirror itself.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: I walked the loop and my compass came back flipped.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Then this cliff can't be oriented. Like the Möbius band.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The two choices make a cover — the Sheet Compass sees it.

videos.title: Both Sides of the Story

scenes.title: Twins

scenes.title: Wraith
scenes.description: A violet wraith claws at the seam.

scenes.title: Ready
scenes.description: Gyroid steps onto the seam.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card at 26: “World 3 · Level 8 — Both Sides of the Story”.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: On a closed, oriented place, every hole has a twin reading on the other side.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Dimension k on this side, n minus k on that one.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: If the place is twisted, count mod 2 and the mirror still works.

videos.title: Perfect Pairing

scenes.description: Gyroid squares the middle lantern of two models: one blazes, one stays dark.

scenes.title: The station
scenes.description: The Counterfeit Station's lights in the distance.

scenes.description: Title card at 22: “World 3 · Level 9 — Perfect Pairing”.

captions.text: On a closed manifold, every lantern has a partner. Their product is the top.

videos.title: The Counterfeit Station

scenes.title: The master

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The Commutator. You don't give up.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: Your counting forgot order once. It will forget again.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary

videos.title: Snap to Grid
